name: Bottle of Zombie Juice
summary: In Darkshire, a Bottle of Zombie Juice is bound for Abercrombie, a reclusive hermit in Duskwood. The potent liquor is brewed from rot blossom, and Abercrombie says he needs it to keep warm.

sections.title: A Pungent Concoction
sections.body: Rot blossoms gathered in Duskwood go into this harsh brew. The bartender in Darkshire warns that it is potent enough to raise the dead. Most folk want nothing to do with such a vile drink, but Abercrombie, an eccentric hermit, says it is the only thing that keeps him warm on the damp, cold nights by his lonely shack.

sections.title: Questionable Thirst
sections.body: Abercrombie calls the liquor a fiery nightcap. When he receives the bottle, he nearly praises the courier’s foolishness instead of their kindness. What use could he have for a drink so potent?

faq.q: What is Zombie Juice made from?
faq.answer: Zombie Juice is distilled from rot blossoms, a foul-smelling plant found in Duskwood’s corrupted soil.
Abercrombie wants the bottle delivered to his solitary shack along Duskwood’s western borders.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want Zombie Juice?
faq.answer: Abercrombie claims the fiery drink keeps his old bones warm through Duskwood’s bitter, dark nights, though his strange manner suggests he may have another use for so potent a brew.

faq.q: Can players drink the Bottle of Zombie Juice?
faq.answer: No. This bottle is meant for delivery to Abercrombie, and you must carry it safely to his shack.

angles.text: Herbalists familiar with Duskwood know rot blossom is unfit for ordinary restorative tonics, which makes its use in a drink unsettling.
Errands between Darkshire and the shadowed wilderness help connect Duskwood’s troubled inhabitants, even when the work seems dubious.
